key_claims.claim: Medium-coverage WGS detects AOH at the sample level with 97% sensitivity compared to CMA, but misses approximately 47% of AOH segments in the 5-10 Mb range
Maternal sirolimus administration for fetal extensive lymphatic malformations is associated with mild maternal toxicity, confirmed transplacental transfer, and preliminary evidence of lesion response
Pre-EXIT fetoscopic airway assessment confirmed patency in 11% of cases, enabling downgrade from EXIT to cesarean, with 100% delivery-room survival across the series
Among prenatally reported VUS selected through MDT review, 56% were subsequently reclassified as likely pathogenic or pathogenic, predominantly through post-mortem or postnatal phenotypic data
Approximately 51% of patients undergoing open fetal MMC repair screen positive for depression preoperatively, declining to 25% in the postpartum period
